I am a Digital Experimentation Analyst at Ulta Beauty with experience across product analytics, operations analytics, KPI reporting, dashboard development, and growth strategy. View Full ExperienceView Consulting Options My approach Start with the question. Build only what helps answer it. My work begins with the business question and the person who needs to act on the answer. Then I define the measurement, inspect the data, build the simplest useful output, and explain the result in language stakeholders can use. My independent practice centers on defined projects and structured advisory deliverables. I work best with teams that value clear ownership, asynchronous updates, professional handoffs, and honest recommendations about what the data can and cannot support. My background in experimentation and conversion analysis informs evidence-based digital experience recommendations. Tools matter, but they do not lead the conversation. A dashboard, experiment readout, or reporting model is useful only when the team understands the metric, trusts the input, and knows what decision the output should inform. Professional proof A/B + MVTexperiment analysis across digital experiences Web + Appcustomer behavior and KPI measurement Product + BIdecision support, dashboards, and reporting Growthmarket insight, KPI frameworks, and recommendations Expertise Measurement, analysis, reporting, and workflow design. I work across the layers needed to move from a business question to a usable output. Product analytics KPI strategy, funnel thinking, segmentation, web and app behavior, customer outcomes, and decision-ready readouts. Experimentation background Professional experience with hypothesis design, A/B and multivariate testing, statistical significance, sample size, traffic allocation, and test duration informs my digital experience assessments. Independent engagements focus on assessment and recommendations; live experimentation operations are not offered. BI & data Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, Salesforce reporting, and cloud data tools. Growth strategy Discovery, market and competitor analysis, KPI framing, digital performance review, and prioritized recommendations. Relevant background Different environments, one consistent job: make the decision clearer. These categories describe my professional and academic background. Employers and academic affiliations are distinct from independent consulting clients. Professional experience Digital experimentation Hands-on A/B and multivariate test analysis, personalization measurement, audience logic, KPI impact, and executive-ready recommendations. Professional experience Operations BI Geospatial reporting, SQL and Python automation, KPI visibility, stakeholder requirements, and decision support for planning teams. Direct consulting proof Client strategy Discovery, SEO and campaign analysis, competitor research, KPI frameworks, structured recommendations, and leadership presentation. Analytics competition Demand forecasting Time-series analysis, forecast evaluation, scenario interpretation, and a recommendation built for business stakeholders. Invalid output, timeouts, or uncertain cases go to manual review.5. Human reviewA person checks the original message and proposed summary, chooses the service fit, and writes or approves a response.6. Log the reviewed outcomeRecord the approved category and review status under the team’s retention policy. No automated production action is taken. Defined projects. Useful insights. Professional handoffs.
Six ways to move your business forward.

The Analytics Clarity Audit is a $500–$900 project for founders and small teams with conflicting KPIs, unreliable analytics, or reporting gaps, ending in a diagnostic report, measurement recommendations, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.

The Dashboard & Reporting Sprint is a $1,200–$2,500 project for teams that need reusable business intelligence and executive reporting, covering KPI definitions, a dashboard or reporting model with validation checks, and documentation and handoff.

The Digital Experience & Growth Opportunity Audit is a project, quoted after scoping, that reviews agreed customer journeys, conversion paths, and available analytics and delivers an audit report with an impact-versus-effort opportunity backlog.

The Applied AI Workflow Sprint is a project, quoted after scoping, for businesses and agencies with repetitive, non-critical workflows, covering workflow assessment, AI workflow design and agreed automation implementation, and testing, documentation, and handoff.

Monthly Reporting Support is a recurring service at $1,200–$2,500/mo for growing organizations that need a regular interpretation of performance, with a monthly KPI summary, performance analysis, and agreed dashboard updates and recommendations.

Structured Analytics Advisory is a recurring service at $1,200–$2,500/mo for founders and digital teams seeking periodic analytics strategy and practical decision guidance, with scheduled strategic consultations, analytics roadmap reviews, and periodic advisory deliverables.
Use the KPI / Dashboard Readiness Checklist.
What is included in a project?
Every engagement has an agreed scope, deliverables, milestones, deadlines, and review points before work begins. Each service card above lists its expected deliverables.

Services do not include emergency response, on-call coverage, real-time monitoring, or live experimentation operations. Additional work, revisions beyond the agreed scope, maintenance, and support require separate scoping and approval.
Do I need to buy a BI tool?

Not necessarily. Excel, SQL, Python, or an existing BI platform can be used where appropriate. Your team supplies relevant secure exports or least-privilege access and any required paid software licenses.
Should I start with an audit or a sprint?

An analytics audit identifies the decision, metric gaps, data quality issues, and reporting workflow problems before a team invests in a build. A Dashboard & Reporting Sprint builds the reporting deliverable itself, with KPI definitions, validation checks, documentation, and handoff. You can start with an analytics or digital experience audit, build a reporting or AI workflow deliverable, or agree a recurring reporting or advisory package.
How is the final price set?

Published ranges are in USD and depend on the agreed deliverables, data readiness, and complexity. The Digital Experience & Growth Opportunity Audit and the Applied AI Workflow Sprint are quoted after scoping. Scope, timeline, and price are confirmed in a written proposal before any work begins.

These services cover analytics, business intelligence, digital experience assessment, and applied AI for startups, founders, Chicago and other small businesses, agencies, nonprofits, workforce boards, and growing organizations.

/experience/.main_visible_text: Anthony BaptisteAnalytics & Applied AI Menu Work Experience Consulting Contact Connect on LinkedIn Experience Professional experience across digital experimentation, product analytics, operations, and research. My current role at Ulta Beauty comes first. The earlier roles show the foundation behind it: stakeholder partnership, KPI definition, dashboarding, quantitative analysis, and clear business recommendations. Employers are not presented as independent consulting clients. Select a role Digital Experimentation Analyst - Ulta Beauty AI/NLP Researcher - NIU College of Business Growth Consultant - Mystery Street Recording Company Network Planning Analyst Intern - Shipt IT Data Analyst - Innovation DuPage Leadership & Industry Presentations - NIU June 2026 - Present | Ulta Beauty | Bolingbrook, IL Digital Experimentation Analyst - Ulta Beauty Digital Experimentation At Ulta Beauty, I support A/B and multivariate testing across web and app experiences. The work focuses on defining hypotheses, measurement strategies, KPIs, and success criteria before evaluating how digital changes affect customers and business performance. What I did Support digital experiments by helping define hypotheses, measurement strategies, KPIs, and success criteria. Analyze experiment performance with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, and Excel across conversion, revenue, engagement, and customer behavior. Evaluate statistical significance, sample size requirements, minimum detectable effects, traffic allocation, and test duration. Partner with Product, eCommerce, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn business questions into measurable experiments and actionable readouts. What this demonstrates: practical experience connecting experimentation design, product metrics, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder recommendations. May 2025 - May 2026 | Northern Illinois University | DeKalb, IL Undergraduate Student Researcher - NIU College of Business Applied AI Research I contribute to research on how large language models can support interview-based qualitative research without replacing human interpretation. The work combines prompt design, transcript generation, NLP evaluation, qualitative research methods, and practical awareness of tools like Claude, Custom GPTs, MCP-style connections, and n8n automation. What I did Built a GPT-based simulation pipeline that generated AI interview transcripts for 28 founder personas using consistent structured prompts, with patterns transferable to Claude and Custom GPT workflows. Compared AI-generated and human interview responses across tone, depth, factual accuracy, strengths, weaknesses, and alignment gaps. Developed a Python NLP workflow for thematic coding and sentiment scoring so transcript analysis could be evaluated more systematically. Helped design a qualitative evaluation framework with faculty mentors that balances quantitative signals with human interpretation. What this demonstrates: structured AI-assisted research, qualitative analysis, evaluation, and responsible human oversight. August 2025 - December 2025 | Mystery Street Recording Company | Chicago, IL Growth Consultant - Mystery Street Recording Company Growth Consulting Through NIU's Experiential Learning Center, I worked on a consulting engagement for a Chicago-based recording studio. The project required turning ambiguous growth goals, fragmented market information, and competitor activity into a structured recommendation set for leadership. What I did Led business analysis across SEO performance, engagement metrics, campaign KPIs, competitor positioning, and customer segments. Analyzed 15+ competitor studios to define audience segments, market opportunities, and measurable success criteria. Translated fragmented market and demand data into KPI frameworks and strategic recommendations around growth, audience targeting, and marketing investment. Owned deliverables from data gathering through executive presentation, incorporating feedback so the final recommendations were practical for a real client. What this demonstrates: discovery, market analysis, structured recommendations, and presentation to non-technical leadership. May 2025 - August 2025 | Shipt | Birmingham, AL Network Planning - Shipt Operations BI At Shipt, I worked on network planning analytics for a large delivery operation. The role gave me hands-on experience building analytics systems for operational teams that needed better visibility into ZIP-code coverage, daily order volume, and market-level performance. What I did Designed and deployed a Tableau geospatial analytics platform analyzing daily order volume across 30,000+ ZIP codes. Helped Market Operations surface delivery blind spots, misconfigured ZIP-code coverage, and high-risk network regions with 30% better KPI visibility. Built SQL and Python ETL pipelines to process daily delivery data and automate Tableau extract refreshes, eliminating 10+ hours of manual reporting per week. Partnered with Market Operations and Network Planning stakeholders to translate ambiguous operational questions into dashboard requirements and reliable reporting outputs for 5+ planning teams. What this demonstrates: dashboard development, automated reporting, KPI definition, and decision support for operations teams. March 2025 - May 2025 | Innovation DuPage | Glen Ellyn, IL IT Data Analyst Intern - Innovation DuPage KPI Reporting At Innovation DuPage, I supported reporting and operational analysis across program areas. The work focused on making program performance easier to measure, improving Salesforce reporting visibility, and giving leadership more consistent KPI definitions. What I did Built and maintained Tableau dashboards tracking 20+ KPIs across program areas. Standardized metric definitions and reporting logic, reducing reporting cycle time by 40%. Used SQL and Excel transformation workflows to clean and structure raw program data for downstream analysis. Applied Excel-based modeling to identify engagement, utilization, and cohort trends that informed outreach strategy and resource allocation. Improved Salesforce CRM reporting workflows so stakeholders had better visibility into program performance. What this demonstrates: KPI reporting, participant analysis, Salesforce visibility, and decision support in a startup-incubator environment. 2022 - Present | Northern Illinois University Leadership & Industry Presentations - OMIS IGNITE, ACM NIU, and HAVI Public Proof My leadership and presentation experience shows that I can communicate technical work clearly, organize professional development opportunities, and present analytics recommendations to people outside the classroom. What I did Won 1st Place in the NIU Data Visualization Competition with HAVI by building a Power BI dashboard using Python and Excel to analyze QSR supply chain inefficiencies. Presented findings and recommendations to an industry panel of supply chain professionals and data scientists. Founded and chaired OMIS IGNITE, a student-led initiative connecting Operations and Information Management students with professional development, speaker panels, workshops, and networking opportunities. Helped coordinate ACM NIU events, promote technical learning opportunities, and connect peers with professional resources. What this demonstrates: leadership, presentation, organization, and the ability to explain analytics work to real audiences.
